messages:
Lena (Sales): CardinalAI asked for a concise perf POC to validate latency/throughput before procurement. Targets: smoke 20 qps, sustained 200 qps for 15m, microburst 800 qps for 20s. Response size ~100 tokens. They want p95 < 150ms and p99 < 350ms. Can we outline runbook + cost estimate (< $1.5k preferred)?

Diego (Solutions): Quick checks: model float16 7B, single-region (us-west) OK, KMS for logs yes? Anything on private networking?

Lena (Sales): They will use float16 7B, single-region us-west, KMS yes, private network not required for POC.

Rina (Eng-ML): Proposed run stages: 1) smoke 5m at 20 qps; 2) warm ramp to 200 qps over 4m then hold 15m; 3) burst ramp to 800 qps over 10s hold 20s; 4) cooldown. Prewarm 8m synthetic to populate KV cache. Recommend batching target 10-14 and enable prefix caching for templates. Use q4_0 as optional run to show cost/latency tradeoff.

Omar (SRE): Telemetry: p50/p95/p99, queue depth, GPU util, instance count, reject rate. Autoscale config: min=2, max=8 for hosted pool. Abort burst if GPU util >85% for 30s. We'll create ephemeral pool.

Priya (Security): KMS for artifacts and logs is fine. Default retention 90d but we can set to 30d for this POC. Need clarification if they want customer-managed CMK.

DeployBot: Ephemeral pool created: pool-id pcp-1745556666, region us-west-2, max-instances 8. Dashboard: /dash/pcp-1745556666. Logs retention set to 30d.

Rina (Eng-ML): Quick micro-sim (internal harness) results for baseline float16 at 200 qps, 100-token responses: median 55ms, p95 120ms, p99 280ms with batching=12. q4_0 quant: median 38ms, p95 85ms, p99 210ms. During a simulated 800 qps burst p99 spikes to ~430ms for float16 and ~280ms for q4_0; we saw increased retries when autoscale hit max. CSV attached.

Diego (Solutions): Cost sketch (Hosted): ~ $600-1,300 depending on soak length and choice of quant. With short prewarm and q4_0 primary run we can aim ~ $1k. We'll prepare a one-page cost note for procurement.

Lena (Sales): Excellent. Action items: Diego cost note, Priya sec one-pager (CMK question), Omar finalizes pool + dashboard, Rina attach request.json and CSV. I'll schedule kickoff tomorrow 10am PT. :+1:

Rina (Eng-ML): Sample vegeta command for sustained stage:

```
vegeta attack -targets=targets.txt -rate=200 -duration=15m | vegeta report
```

Burst stage: `vegeta attack -rate=800 -duration=20s`.

Omar (SRE): I'll enable traces and instance-level metrics on the dashboard.

Lena (Sales): Thanks everyone  we'll confirm client and share docs before kickoff.
